project_title: HydroFlow: Multispectral Satellite Water Segmentation & Generative Flow Matching
author: Mohamed Mostafa Elbasyouni

bands.name: B3
bands.label: Green (Golden)
bands.role: Maximum water reflectance peak, NDWI numerator

bands.name: B8
bands.label: Broad NIR (Golden)
bands.role: Critical high water absorption (R ~ 0) vs vegetation (R ~ 0.5)

bands.name: B11
bands.label: SWIR-1 (Golden)
bands.role: Soil moisture, cloud/snow vs water separation, MNDWI

bands.name: B12
bands.label: SWIR-2 (Golden)
bands.role: Hydrothermal minerals, complex geology, deep water absorption

stages.name: Variance Filter
stages.description: Rejects degenerate flat/solid scenes lacking spatial texture.

stages.name: NIR Physical Absorption
stages.description: Enforces physical spectral law: NIR must absorb in water areas.

stages.name: Spatial Morphological IoU
stages.description: Enforces structural alignment with conditioning binary mask.

models.name: Pretrained ResNet-34 U-Net (12-Band)
models.description: ImageNet pretrained backbone with adapted 12-channel conv1 stem. Decisively captures complex coastlines and fine tributaries.

models.name: Pretrained ResNet-34 U-Net (6-Band Golden)
models.description: Golden 6-band subset with pretrained spatial filters. Reaches 91.83% Precision with 50% less satellite transmission volume.

models.name: Pretrained EfficientNet-B0 U-Net (12-Band)
models.description: Compact inverted residual architecture. Reaches 76.56% IoU with ONLY 6.25M params—nearly 4x smaller than ResNet-34.

models.name: Pretrained EfficientNet-B0 U-Net (6-Band Golden)
models.description: Fast lightweight configuration for onboard edge processing. Outperforms 6-band scratch model by +9.90% IoU.

models.name: Custom U-Net from Scratch (12-Band)
models.description: Standard multispectral 4-level encoder-decoder with skip connections, trained from scratch without inductive priors.

models.name: OT-CFM Generative Retrained U-Net (6-Band)
models.description: Augmented with 509 high-fidelity synthetic scenes generated via 2nd-order Heun solver and vetted through physical gatekeeper (+3.18% IoU boost).

models.name: Custom U-Net from Scratch (6-Band Golden)
models.description: Golden subset without pretraining. Illustrates the severe -8.42% IoU penalty when removing bands without ImageNet priors.
